messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx and request latency from model variant 'omega-v4' across us-west-2. error-rate ~4.2% (threshold 0.5%). auto-slo fallback triggered.
jamie: i'm paged, looking. seeing large tail latencies and KV cache misses. reproducible on long-context chat routes.
liam: any customer-facing errors reported yet?
maya: a few support tickets from enterprise keys E-739 and E-812 reporting timeouts. no broad outage.
jamie: ok plan: soft-demote omega-v4 weight to 10%, divert 80% to omega-v3-stable, leave 10% for probe. apply per-key emergency rate-limit for heavy keys. notify customers.
sarah: +1. start with routing change then rate limits. I'll take on customer comms.
jamie: running graceful routing change now:
```
rhctl route update --model=omega --variant=omega-v4 --weight=10 --graceful=true --timeout=300
rhctl route update --model=omega --variant=omega-v3-stable --weight=80 --graceful=true --timeout=300
```
deploy-bot: routing update started (job id: job_8792). progress: 0/3 regions.
liam: setting temporary per-key caps for top 20 heavy keys to 5 rps\/key to reduce tail queuing.
jamie: applying quota slice:
```
rhctl quota set --scope=customer:E-* --limit=5rps --duration=30m --reason="incident mitigation"
```
maya: done, confirmed applied in us-west-2. metrics show queue depth falling ~18% after 2min.
sarah: contacting E-739 and E-812 with a heads-up and mitigation ETA ~15m. drafting note. :envelope_with_arrow:
customer-ops: notified E-739 (account rep pinged). they're asking for an SLA impact estimate.
jamie: if probe traffic still shows elevated errors after routing, we will rollback omega-v4 -> omega-v3-stable entirely for the day and open postmortem.
liam: probe reports: omega-v4 error rate now 1.1% (was 4.2%), latency p95 reduced but still noisy on long-context.
jamie: decision: continue soft-demote for 10m, if error >1% then full rollback. @sarah please prep rollback playbook.
sarah: ack, prepping rollback steps and release notes.
jamie: deploy-bot reports routing update completed in 3 regions.
maya: queue depth stable, request success rate improving.
liam: but seeing a small regression in generation quality on omega-v3 for prompt family X - running evals to quantify.
sarah: customer-ops: E-739 accepts mitigation, wants timeline for permanent fix. logging action item.
jamie: 10m probe window started.
... 10m later ...
jamie: probe: omega-v4 error rate back up to 1.6% and p95 growth resumed. rolling back omega-v4 out of production. initiating full traffic switch to omega-v3-stable and start temporary variant shutdown.
jamie: executing rollback command:
```
rhctl route update --model=omega --variant=omega-v4 --weight=0 --graceful=false --drain=60
rhctl route update --model=omega --variant=omega-v3-stable --weight=100
infra deploy rollback --model=omega --from=omega-v4 --to=omega-v3-stable --force
```
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (job id: job_8793).
liam: applying emergency key-slice extension for affected customers so their flows are stable during switch.
maya: confirmed all traffic now on omega-v3-stable. error-rate back to baseline 0.2%, latency p95 nominal. :white_check_mark:
sarah: customer comms sent to E-739 and E-812 with apology and mitigation summary.
jamie: oncall handoff: i'm staying for immediate verification for 30m, then @sarah will take over night oncall. please escalate if any regressions.
sarah: taking handoff at 2026-03-17T23:30Z. documenting actions in incident ticket INC-2026-431.
jamie: root cause hypothesis: kernel-level attention optimization in omega-v4 interacting badly with long-context KV cache evictions under heavy, skewed key traffic. adding to triage.
liam: opened ticket ENG-1219 for deep-dive, assigning to eng-ml.
maya: quick followups: pin omega-v3-stable as fallback for 24h, disable auto-rollout for omega-v4 variants until signoff.
jamie: noted. also enabling increased sampling for prompt family X so we can monitor quality after the switch.
sarah: final: no broad customer outage, impacted enterprise keys had degraded throughput but received mitigation. will kick off postmortem and coordinate a remediation timeline. handing off. :handshake:
